body_lead: In a pioneering move to bridge the gap between unskilled labour backgrounds and high-demand digital careers, the Assam Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (ABOCWWB), under the Labour Welfare Department, has signed a landmark Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with the Indian Institute of Technology Guwahati (IIT-G). The collaboration will provide residential training in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning (AI/ML) to 100 candidates from families of registered construction workers across the state.
